_how_to_use: Copy this file to data/personas/my-path.json (any name not ending in .template.json) and fill in your real record.
The app lists it on the landing page as a one-click profile. Keep it out of git if it holds your real grades.
program_id: pick one from GET /api/programs (for example computer-science-2025-26).
first_term / plan_from: YYYYFA, YYYYSP, YYYYSU or YYYYWI. plan_from is the first term still to plan.
completed: every course with its grade (A, B, C, D, F, P, W); set source to transfer for courses taken elsewhere, using the ATU equivalent code.
in_progress: codes you're taking now; they're assumed passed.
exams: CLEP scores as {program, exam, score}, with the exam name as listed on the Exam opportunities tab.
Levers and preferences can be changed in the app after loading.
name: My path
story: Filled in by the owner from their own transcript.
